items.exampleEn: Stand up and say hello to the class.
He took his hat off and sat down.
We threw away a lot of old magazines.
items.exampleZh: 我們丟掉了很多舊雜誌。

items.exampleEn: She turned the radio on and started to sing.
items.exampleZh: 她打開收音機，開始唱歌。

items.exampleEn: Don't forget to turn off the TV before bed.
I often wake up at night when it is too hot.
items.exampleZh: 太熱的時候，我晚上常常會醒來。

items.exampleEn: Dad cooks, and I wash up.

items.audioEn: The plane took off an hour late because of the rain.
items.audioZh: 因為下雨，飛機晚了一個小時起飛。
options: It landed at the wrong airport
It left much later than planned

items.sentenceEn: Please wake me up at six tomorrow.

items.sentenceZh: 孩子們，晚餐前先去洗手洗臉！

items.stemEn: I want to watch the news. Can you ____ the TV?
items.stemZh: 我想看新聞，你可以打開電視嗎？

items.stemEn: It's warm inside, so you can ____ your coat.
items.stemZh: 室內很暖和，所以你可以把外套脫下來。

items.passageEn: Tom has a busy schedule every morning. His alarm clock rings at six. He wakes up, but he stays in bed for five more minutes. Then he stands up and turns the alarm off. He washes up and eats breakfast with his family. Before he leaves, he throws away the empty milk bottle. He is never late for school.
items.passageZh: Tom 每天早上都很忙。他的鬧鐘六點響。他醒來了，但會在床上多待五分鐘。然後他站起來，把鬧鐘關掉。他去洗手洗臉，再和家人一起吃早餐。出門前，他把空的牛奶瓶丟掉。他上學從來不遲到。

questions.questionZh: 鬧鐘響了以後，Tom 先做什麼？

referenceEn: It's dark now. Let's turn on the light.
It's getting dark. Let's turn the lights on.
rubricZh: 建議用片語表達，例如 turn on the light、turn the lights on 等，受詞可放後面或中間
不用片語但意思正確的說法（例如 switch on the light、put the light on 等）也算對
「天黑了」可寫，例如 It's dark now、It's getting dark 等；light 單複數都可以
「我們⋯吧」可寫，例如 Let's… 等

items.promptZh: 請不要把這些舊照片丟掉。
referenceEn: Please don't throw away these old photos.
Please don't throw these old photos away.
Don't throw away these old photos, please.
rubricZh: 建議用片語表達，例如 throw away these photos、throw these photos away 等
不用片語但意思正確的說法（例如 throw out these photos、get rid of these photos 等）也算對
否定祈使句可寫，例如 Please don't…、Don't…, please 等
「這些舊照片」可寫，例如 these old photos、these old pictures 等
